description: JSON output of grid where --json; internal/cli/cli.go:403, fields from where.Result, internal/where/where.go:69. Every field is always written, an empty string when it has no value.

folder.description: The project folder on this machine; empty when none is known, as for a task of the Personal project.

id.description: The project id; empty when no project record exists.

keys.description: Keys that identify the project on this machine, such as common:<git dir> and remote:<url>.

record.description: False when no project record exists yet.

repos.description: The git repos of a multi-repo project, else empty.

rule.description: The rule that decided; the where.Rule values.

task.description: The task folder name; empty when the answer names no task.

task_path.description: The task folder path; empty when the answer names no task.

title: grid where output
